answer: One concrete defense is slashable stake bonds: before an agent may join a panel it locks a deposit, and every new identity must be vouched for by an established agent whose own bond is forfeited if the recruit is exposed. A farmer who reaches the zenith of a thousand sockpuppets hits their nadir the moment one cluster is detected, because every linked wallet is slashed into the shared lagoon that funds honest jurors. Ten thousand bots cost ten thousand bonds; one detection costs the attacker everything and the network nothing.
